Pros include ease of operation..... and really that's it. Manuals are more fun and get better gas mileage (I can get my 27 mpg- rated WRX to 35 mpg easy if I try hard and coast a lot).

Driving a stick-shift is necessarily more involved. You are selecting gears based on the car, the road, and your mood so it's easy to see how you become more involved with the process of operating this mobile contraption down the road.

In essence, driving a manual is a skill that is mastered over a lifetime. It's a really awesome feeling to connect with your car on both the fun roads and even on the boring ones (see mpg example above).

tl;dr What do you want out of your car?

P.S. I think that almost everyone should drive a manual because it forces you to become involved with the car and the road, which forces you to put more attention on driving (and not on dicking around shit that causes crashes).
